name: Patollo
source:
Witch class.
Patollo's introverted personality and negative way of thinking has earned her the reputation of the most unwitchlike witch at the academy.
Her cowardice and overly dramatic reactions tend to be a source of amusement for the other witches, and they often tease and play pranks on her.
She tries her best not to make others uncomfortable, but her attempts often miss their mark, so saying "sorry" has become second nature to her.
